description: Morning Brief — today's meetings, what you owe each attendee, and anything overdue. Composed once and emailed to you alone.
name: autopilot_morning_brief

message.value: Load the otto-brief skill and follow the morning brief section exactly. Compose today's brief, store one row in briefs, then send it with send_brief_email. Ground every line in a real commitment and never invent one. If it has already gone today, say so and stop rather than sending a second copy.
